choice: The page polls /api/state every 1.5 s. The helper asks cmux only while the page has polled within 10 s, and Linear at most once a minute per workspace context, on a workspace or branch change, or on the refresh button. A context ignores cmux's automatic workspace renames; only an issue ID in the title counts.
consequences: Several cmux windows share one helper and show the workspace the CLI reports as selected.
context: The user accepted that nothing updates while the panel is hidden.
rejected: Polling every workspace in the background to show status pills in the native list (that feature was dropped); subscribing to cmux's event stream (not needed for the first version).
title: Refresh only while the page is open
